name: our-maps
description: App to create and share sets of location pins

scripts.dev:client: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:3002 && cd client && npm run dev
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.setup:maps: node scripts/download-map.js --sample && node scripts/download-sprites.mjs && node scripts/download-fonts.mjs
scripts.setup:maps:full: node scripts/download-map.js --full && node scripts/download-sprites.mjs && node scripts/download-fonts.mjs
scripts.build: npm run setup:sprites -- --if-missing && npm run setup:fonts -- --if-missing && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix client run build" "npm --prefix server run build"
scripts.build:fast: npm run setup:sprites -- --if-missing && npm run setup:fonts -- --if-missing && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "VITE_NO_PWA=true npm --prefix client run build:fast" "npm --prefix server run build" "npm --prefix client run typecheck"
